releases.name: sync-od v0.1.5
releases.body:
## sync-od v0.1.5

Sync any codebase to your self-hosted Open Design MCP and/or extract its
design system.

**Install:**
```bash
npm i @ross-sec/sync-od
```

Then add it to `opencode.json`:
```jsonc
{ "plugin": ["@ross-sec/sync-od"] }
```

**Changes:** see [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/ross-sec/sync-od/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
